text:
harper: opened an urgent docs PR to patch the outage page and add a short workaround + status link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4780. Need fast reviews and a merge. Preview keeps failing on CI.

ned: jumping in. which files?

harper: docs/serving/rate-limits.md, docs/sdk/python/retries.md, and a new note in docs/known-issues/outage-mar-21.md. Also replaced an inline api_key example in sdk snippet.

zoe: quick scan  snippet sanitized, only one wording nit about "burst window" vs "burst policy" for Dedicated customers. I can push that edit.

docs-bot: preview build queued #2401

docs-bot: preview failed #2401  Linkcheck error: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-742 returned 503

harper: ugh the status page is flakey — the linkcheck will block the hotfix. I don't want to change content just to get CI green. Options: whitelist the single link in CI, or temporarily point to the status homepage anchor. Thoughts?

ned: prefer whitelist so the docs content stays accurate. Add an entry to .docsci/whitelist-links.txt and note it in the PR description.

zoe: also add a short PR note explaining the CI override so reviewers know it's intentional.

harper: done  added whitelist entry and PR note. retriggering preview.

docs-bot: preview succeeded #2402  preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4780

ned: LGTM content-wise after the small wording tweak. Approving.

zoe: Approved. Note: ops has a deploy freeze for config pushes until 11:00 UTC. This is docs-only but ops requested a waiver to push live. SRE signoff required.

sre-lead: SRE here  reviewed the patch. Docs-only change, OK to waive freeze. We'll watch rate-limit and token-bucket metrics for 20m post-deploy and will escalate if 429s spike.

harper: merging and backporting to branch live-docs now.

deploy-bot: PR merged by harper  backport job queued

deploy-bot: backport succeeded  branch live-docs

deploy-bot: starting live docs deploy job #1203  monitoring 429/500/503 metrics

sre-lead: watching. If we see token-bucket symptoms we will revert to previous live-docs commit.

deploy-bot: live deploy succeeded  job #1203  docs available at https://docs.redwood.ai/known-issues/outage-mar-21

ned: verified the page and image assets load. Status link resolves when status page responds.

zoe: added a changelog line in /changelog/2026-03-21.md noting the hotfix and the CI whitelist entry.

harper: filed a followup issue to add a docs-ci retry + selective linkcheck backoff for status.redwood.ai: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/121. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
